text:
deploy-bot: starting gradual rollout slice 6/12 for v2 on api.redwood.com (deploy=rb-7412340000). watch window 20m. ops watchers: @sam @priya. route split: /chat + /generate -> v2 for unpinned tenants.
sam: grabbing this. quick context: we've seen client ambiguity when X-Api-Version header is missing; some clients implicitly land on v1 during staged routing which is expected. plan: pre-pin tenants flagged by matcher for old-sdks or high mobile streaming.
priya: ran matcher: candidates with sdk_version < 3.2.5 OR mobile_ratio > 0.4 -> 5 tenants. I'll apply ephemeral pins (48h) with reason metadata. Use expiry to avoid manual cleanup.
jules: during a small canary earlier EU saw a transient 429 cluster concentrated on streaming-enabled tenants. recommend pin for t-9090 and t-9191 immediately.
marco: adding rollback thresholds: sustained v2_error_rate >= 3% for 5m OR v2_429_ratio >= 0.05 for 4m -> rollback. latency circuit: p95 > 900ms for 3 consecutive 1m buckets -> auto-fallback to v1. stream-reset rule: stream_reset_rate > 0.6% for 3m -> immediate fallback.
sam: command to pin: `deploybot pin-tenant --id t-9090 --route v1 --reason "streaming 429 risk" --expires 2026-04-06T18:00:00Z`
deploy-bot: pin request received for t-9090 by sam, applying now.
deploy-bot: pin applied: t-9090 -> v1 (rb-7412340000-pinA).
sam: applying second: `deploybot pin-tenant --id t-9191 --route v1 --reason "legacy sdk + mobile" --expires 2026-04-06T18:00:00Z`
deploy-bot: pin applied: t-9191 -> v1 (rb-7412340000-pinB).
priya: applying auto-rule pins for the remaining matcher results (3 tenants) with expiry 48h and reason tag `old-sdk/header-missing`.
deploy-bot: auto-pin applied: t-8202 -> v1 (rb-7412340000-pinC), t-8303 -> v1 (rb-7412340000-pinD), t-8404 -> v1 (rb-7412340000-pinE).
jules: re-ran smoke across EU/US slices: p50 latency +9ms, no sustained 429 spikes in 12m. looks stable; propose advancing to slice 7 after full 20m.
marco: updated runbook entry with these thresholds and a quick command cheat-sheet: https://go.redwood/runbooks/v2-rollout-cheatsheet. also added pager rule: auto-fallback -> page infra@oncall.
sam: release notes blurb (will PR): "During staged v2 rollout, clients that do not provide X-Api-Version may be routed to v1. To ensure v2 behavior include header `X-Api-Version: v2` or upgrade SDK >= 3.2.5. Retry guidance for 429: exponential backoff with jitter (base 250ms)."
priya: I'll add a short SDK snippet in the docs and ping partners after 30m stable.
jules: leaving this thread as the single source of truth for the pre-pin decisions and expiry times. will unpin automatically on expiry; reopen thread if we need manual extension.
deploy-bot: watch window active. will post final status at end of window or on any trigger. :eyes:
